State Longitudinal Data Systems (SLDS) Program catalog metadata

## Catalog metadata

- **Steward:** National Center for Education Statistics
- **Access:** State-administered systems; no single national public microdata file
- **Access URL:** https://nces.ed.gov/programs/slds/
- **Unit:** State-specific linked administrative record
- **Coverage:** State-dependent
- **Update cadence:** State-dependent
- **Geography:** state, district, school, student where authorized
- **Join keys:** state student identifier, district and school identifiers, school year, state program identifiers
- **Measures:** enrollment, assessment, course taking, graduation, postsecondary and workforce links where available
- **Uses:** local evaluation feasibility, longitudinal outcome linkage, implementation exposure measurement

This is an access and evaluation-design layer, not one downloadable national dataset. Any state extract must retain that state's data dictionary, approval record, and disclosure controls.

[Official resource](https://nces.ed.gov/programs/slds/)
